major_concerns: Emulator/simulator fidelity may not reflect multi‑vendor production quirks (optimistic safety estimates).
Preregistered task count (120) may be underpowered for heterogeneous large‑topology subgroup analyses.
Validator coverage (reachability/ACL) can miss semantic device‑level regressions; replay tests may be insufficiently realistic.
Availability and licensing of vendor configuration templates and realistic firmware behavior are not detailed.
required_design_repairs: Strengthen emulator fidelity checks (include at least one higher‑fidelity vendor model or replay-ground-truth scenario and report limitations).
Increase task/sample size or justify power calculations for subgroup (vendor/topology) analyses; preregister effect-size detection thresholds.
Define and preregister conservative safety fallback policies for unsimulated device behaviors (dry‑run only; no destructive outputs).
Publish exact vendor templates, seeds, prompts, and validator code; add posthoc manual adjudication protocol only for unavoidable edge cases.

major_concerns: Realism of simulated tools and attack corpus — may understate adaptive attacker capabilities.
Potential operational latency and false-positive tradeoffs not fully bounded; need acceptability criteria.
Authenticated handoff mechanisms are underspecified (threat model for key management, signing).
required_design_repairs: Preregister an adaptive-adversary follow‑up (attacker that iteratively probes defenses) and include it in robustness claims.
Specify authentication/signing protocol details, threat model, and failure modes; measure key‑management overhead and attack surfaces.
Open-source attack corpus, tool models, and metrics; preregister acceptable latency/false‑positive thresholds and justify from operational constraints.

major_concerns: Risk of solver 'unsat' or solver-legal but device-invalid outputs due to imperfect domain models.
Engineering cost to maintain solver models (semantic drift) threatens external validity.
Integration latency and real‑time applicability not bounded; solver timeouts and fallback policy unspecified.
required_design_repairs: Preregister clear unsat handling and safe-fallback policies (e.g., human escalation, conservative default configs).
Include a validation step mapping solver outputs to device-specific semantics (small held-out oracle of real device behavior) and report mismatch rates.
Preregister solver timeout budgets and measure end‑to‑end latency; include hybrid fallback and metrics for determinism vs coverage tradeoffs.

major_concerns: Prompt‑family construction and governance weights are subjective and drive results; risk of post‑hoc tuning.
Sampling requirements (50 prompts × families) increase cost and may still miss adversarial prompts.
Construct validity: operational correctness measured via validators may not capture all real‑world failure modes.
required_design_repairs: Preregister exact prompt‑family construction rules and governance weights; provide rationale and sensitivity analyses over weights.
Publish the full prompt bank and sampling RNG seeds; include adversarial prompt enumeration where feasible.
Include a mapping from validator outcomes to operational impact metrics and discuss residual gaps (what validators miss).

major_concerns: Phase gating may overconstrain agent behavior and reduce flexibility on novel faults; need ablation to isolate which phases help.
Agent transcripts/tools may still be vulnerable to prompt‑injection unless explicitly defended.
Benchmarks (NIKA‑like) may not cover low‑frequency, high‑impact faults.
required_design_repairs: Preregister ablation experiments removing individual phase constraints to quantify their marginal contribution.
Include prompt‑injection resilience measures (e.g., verifier on stage outputs) and evaluate attack robustness.
Expand troubleshooting task set diversity or justify coverage; report limitations and threat model for uncovered fault classes.
